newsitem.title: USA: Watermarc CEO expands post to president.
newsitem.headline: Watermarc CEO expands post to president.

text.p: Watermarc Food Management Co said on Thursday that its chairman and chief executive officer, Ghulam Bombaywala, had assumed the added responibilities of president and chief operating officer.
Bombaywala replaces president and chief operating officer Angelo Pitillo, who resigned from the company effective June 20, Watermarc said in a statement.
Watermarc, which owns and operates 45 restaurants in the western and southwestern United States, said Pitillo will remain with the company as a consultant.
In addition, Watermarc said Pitillo plans to enter into a franchise agreement with the company to open Origianl Pasta Co restaurants in Atlanta, Georgia.
